info.name: Mirakl Connect Channel Platform APIs Carriers Promotions API

params.name: ids
params.description: A comma separated list of identifiers for shop joined to an identifier for a promotion (structure: "ids=<shopId>|<promotionShopInternalId>,<shopId>|<promotionShopInternalId>, ..." Example: /api/promotion?ids=123|promo-dec-2016)

params.name: types
params.description: A comma separated list of types for a promotion [AMOUNT_OFF|FREE_ITEMS|PERCENTAGE_OFF|REDUCED_UNIT_PRICE]

params.name: states
params.description: A comma separated list of states for a promotion [PENDING|ACTIVE|EXPIRED|PENDING_APPROVAL|REJECTED|ALL]

params.name: shop_ids
params.description: A comma separated list of shop ids

params.name: ending_after
params.description: Returns promotions which ended or will end after this date

params.name: starting_before
params.description: Returns promotions which started or will start before this date

params.name: date_created_from
params.description: Filter promotion creation date lower limit

params.name: date_created_to
params.description: Filter promotion creation date upper limit

params.name: last_request_date
params.description: Last request date and time. We recommend using the differential mode along with the states parameter.

params.name: locale
params.description: The locale to filter the medias and the public descriptions with. If not specified, medias and public descriptions of all locales are returned.If specified, only the media and the public description matching the locale will be returned, or, if not exist, the one matching the platform default locale.

params.name: trigger_offer_ids
params.description: Promotion-triggering offer ids, separated by commas

params.name: reward_offer_ids
params.description: Promotion reward offer ids, separated by commas

params.name: channel_codes
params.description: Channel codes on which promotions apply, separated by commas

params.name: campaign_identifiers
params.description: A comma separated list of campaign identifiers
